mapper.sql: a.att_id, a.user_id, u.name AS user_name, d.dept_nm, a.work_dt, a.check_in, a.check_out, a.status_cd, a.work_min, a.ot_min, a.night_min, a.holiday_min, a.remark
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_attendance (user_id, work_dt, check_in, status_cd, remark) VALUES (#{userId}, #{workDt}, #{checkIn}, COALESCE(#{statusCd},'NORMAL'), #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_attendance SET check_out = #{checkOut}, work_min = #{workMin}, ot_min = #{otMin}, night_min = #{nightMin}, status_cd = COALESCE(#{statusCd}, status_cd), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE att_id = #{attId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_attendance a JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.work_dt = #{workDt}
